scenes.title: Six Forty-Five
scenes.summary: At dawn Bruno draws Chiara a street map to the old hardware shop across the bridge before guests wake up.

scenes.title: The Blue Door
scenes.summary: Across the river Chiara calls Bruno from the square to check the last turn and finds the right brass valve.

scenes.title: Hot Cinnamon Rolls
scenes.summary: Downstairs Giulia and Cesare tempt early-rising Lucia with fresh cinnamon rolls before anyone turns on a cold tap.

scenes.title: Down in the Cellar
scenes.summary: In the cellar Bruno and Chiara swap in the new brass valve and bring hot water roaring back through the house.

scenes.title: Five-Star Showers
scenes.summary: Davide praises the hot shower at breakfast while flustered Cesare accidentally hints that they read his notebook.

scenes.title: The Acoustic Architect
scenes.summary: Under the courtyard tree, Davide shows Chiara and Giulia his sketches: he studies quiet courtyard acoustics, not hotel stars.

scenes.title: Sunlight on the Tag
scenes.summary: While airing out the luggage closet, Bruno brings out the blue suitcase and Lucia recognises the old address in daylight.

scenes.title: The Boy on the Stairs
scenes.summary: In the courtyard Lucia describes the quiet younger brother listening from the stairs just as Davide walks out and hears her.
